about: Cast-card gestures for Minecraft mode (2D ink card 'you' in a voxel world), tuned on the Mob Farm hook (r8-r11). Frames at 30 fps, relative to the preset's start. `events` are McShort cast actions; `expr` names a presets/expressions/<emotion>.json (its face plus its body beats unless beats: false); `path` keys move the card: where = origin (the character's spot) | to (the `to` param) | [dx,dy,dz] offset from origin; squash > 0 crouch, < 0 stretch; arc = jump height. `repeat` repeats `events` every n frames. Expanded by src/director/minecraft/presets.ts.

chop_quick.use: digging / mining fast: repeated short pick chops, the tool stays beside the head (card faces the lens)
chop_quick.anticipation: wind 2 frames (smooth ease-in, top held 2 frames)
chop_quick.followThrough: strike overshoots (back 2.2) then settles in 2 frames
chop_quick.easing: wind: smoothstep; strike: back(2.2) out; settle: smoothstep
chop_quick.notes: Start the first chop ON frame 0-3 so the shot opens mid-strike; pair each strike with a block break (dig) + burst.

chop_heavy.use: one big deliberate swing (first blow, breaking something important)
chop_heavy.anticipation: wind 9 frames, tool raised fully overhead (lift 1)
chop_heavy.followThrough: rest 12 frames: the arm drifts back to idle
chop_heavy.easing: wind: smoothstep; strike: back(2.2) out; settle: smoothstep

startle_hop.use: a jump-scare reaction on the spot: a small hop back, terror face, arms up
startle_hop.anticipation: none (it is a reflex): the stretch starts on frame 0
startle_hop.followThrough: lands with a squash 0.18 and settles in 4 frames

gulp_fear.use: looking at a danger before acting (on the rim): glance down, blink, two gulps
gulp_fear.anticipation: the glance down starts 3 frames early
gulp_fear.followThrough: each gulp is a 10-frame squash bump with a head dip
gulp_fear.notes: Two gulps read; one is lost at Shorts size. Open with 'smile' for 4-6 frames when the shot cuts in so the turn to fear is seen.

nod_commit.use: the decision beat right before a risky move
nod_commit.followThrough: the face morphs to determined over 7 frames

jump_into.use: jumping down into a pit / off a ledge to the `to` point
jump_into.anticipation: crouch squash 0.34 over 5 frames (cubicOut), then a stretch -0.16 on take-off (expoOut, 2 frames)
jump_into.followThrough: land squash 0.32 (cubicOut, 3 frames) then settle to 0 over 4; landing shake + stone burst
jump_into.easing: crouch cubicOut, take-off expoOut, flight linear arc 1.5, land cubicOut
jump_into.notes: Land ON the word (the landing is at +14): r11 landed 5 frames late. Keep the crouch in view: no camera move during frames 0-5.

flinch_recoil.use: something hits / lands right beside you: flinch back with a small hop, terror, gulp

params.to: optional: where the hop ends (default 0.4 back)

flinch_recoil.followThrough: flinch overshoot then a 10-frame settle; gulp at +7

idea_pop.use: the plan clicks: idea face, a quick arm pop
idea_pop.followThrough: arm holds then drops over 8 frames

triumph_pump.use: payoff / showing off: big grin, fist pumps and chuckles, never still
triumph_pump.anticipation: the first pump starts 2 frames before its frame
triumph_pump.followThrough: each raise settles over 8 frames into the next chuckle
triumph_pump.easing: back(2.2) out up, smoothstep down, sine chuckle

blink.use: a single blink (inferred life, or across a hold)
